en.name: Pressure!
en.text: Attack; deal 1 Heart of damage unless blocked.

id.name: Tekan!
id.text: Menyerang; memberi 1 luka jika tidak ditahan.

en.name: Double Down
en.text: Attack; deal 1 damage. If it succeeds, the target discards 1 card.

id.name: Tekan Terus
id.text: Menyerang 1 luka; jika berhasil, target membuang 1 kartu.

en.name: Callout
en.text: Attack; deal 1 damage and ask the target to reveal their last played Action card, if any.

id.name: Tunjuk!
id.text: Menyerang 1 luka; target menunjukkan kartu Aksi terakhir yang pernah dimainkan, jika ada.

en.name: Corner Them
en.text: Attack; deal 1 damage. If the target has 2+ Suspicion, gain Behavior Evidence if they have a recorded qualifying action.

id.name: Sudutkan!
id.text: Menyerang 1 luka; jika target punya Kecurigaan 2+, peroleh Bukti Perilaku bila ada tindakan yang memenuhi syarat.

en.name: Duck!
en.text: Reaction: prevent 1 damage to yourself.

id.name: Menghindar!
id.text: Reaksi: cegah 1 luka pada diri sendiri.

en.name: Deny It
en.text: Reaction: prevent 1 damage to yourself and remove 1 of your Suspicion.

id.name: Bantah!
id.text: Reaksi: cegah 1 luka pada diri sendiri dan kurangi 1 Kecurigaan diri.

en.name: Step In
en.text: Reaction: prevent 1 damage to any target; playable only if that target did not defend.

id.name: Pasang Badan
id.text: Reaksi: cegah 1 luka pada target mana pun, jika target tidak bertahan sendiri.

en.name: Countercheck
en.text: Reaction: prevent 1 damage to yourself; gain Behavior Evidence on the attacker if they have a qualifying public action.

id.name: Periksa Balik
id.text: Reaksi: cegah 1 luka pada diri sendiri; dapatkan Bukti Perilaku dari penyerang jika ada tindakan yang memenuhi syarat.

en.name: Look Back
en.text: Gain Behavior Evidence against a player with a recorded Attack or Noisy action. Otherwise, gain none.

id.name: Telusuri
id.text: Dapatkan Bukti Perilaku dari pemain yang pernah melakukan serangan atau aksi Mencolok. Jika tidak, tidak mendapat Bukti.

en.name: Follow the Trail
en.text: Gain Clue Evidence on a player; privately inspect 1 random card from their hand, if any.

id.name: Ikuti Jejak
id.text: Dapatkan Bukti Petunjuk dari target; lihat 1 kartu acak dari tangannya bila ada.

en.name: Peek
en.text: Privately inspect 1 random card in another player's hand; draw 1 card.

id.name: Intip
id.text: Lihat 1 kartu acak di tangan pemain lain; ambil 1 kartu dari tumpukan.

en.name: Check Alibi
en.text: Gain Clue Evidence on a player; ask them to show their most recently played Action card, if any.

id.name: Cek Alibi
id.text: Dapatkan Bukti Petunjuk dari target; minta tunjukkan kartu Aksi terakhir yang dimainkannya bila ada.

en.name: Point Fingers
en.text: Give another player 1 Suspicion. **Noisy.**

id.name: Tuding
id.text: Beri 1 Kecurigaan kepada pemain lain. Mencolok.

en.name: Clean Slate
en.text: Remove up to 2 of your Suspicion. **Noisy** (then gain 1 back).

id.name: Bersihkan Nama
id.text: Hilangkan hingga 2 Kecurigaan sendiri. Mencolok (lalu dapat 1 lagi).

en.name: Stir the Pot
en.text: Two other Active players each discard 1 card. **Noisy.**

id.name: Adu Domba
id.text: Dua pemain Aktif lain masing-masing membuang 1 kartu. Mencolok.

en.name: Card Swap
en.text: Swap 1 randomly selected card from your hand with 1 from another player's hand.

id.name: Tukar Kartu
id.text: Tukar 1 kartu acak milikmu dengan 1 kartu acak dari pemain lain.

en.name: First Aid
en.text: Restore 1 Heart to yourself or any surviving player, including a Cornered player.

id.name: Pertolongan Pertama
id.text: Pulihkan 1 Hati diri sendiri atau pemain lain yang belum tereliminasi, termasuk yang Terpojok.

en.name: Catch Your Breath
en.text: Draw 2 cards and discard 1 card.

id.name: Tarik Napas
id.text: Ambil 2 kartu, lalu buang 1 kartu.

en.name: Last Chance
en.text: Reaction: if you are Cornered and no accusation was made, recover to 1 Heart immediately.

id.name: Kesempatan Terakhir
id.text: Reaksi: jika Terpojok dan tak ada tuduhan, segera pulih menjadi 1 Hati.

en.name: Patch Up
en.text: Restore 1 of your Hearts and remove 1 Suspicion.

id.name: Pulihkan Diri
id.text: Pulihkan 1 Hati sendiri dan kurangi 1 Kecurigaan.

en.name: Safe Place
en.text: Choose yourself or another Active player; the next damage they would take before your next turn is prevented.

id.name: Tempat Aman
id.text: Pilih diri sendiri atau pemain Aktif lain; cegah luka berikutnya pada target sebelum giliranmu berikutnya.

en.name: Extra Clue
en.text: Gain Clue Evidence against one player and inspect 1 random card from their hand; they may discard 1 card to prevent the inspection (but not the Evidence).

id.name: Petunjuk Tambahan
id.text: Dapatkan Bukti Petunjuk dan lihat 1 kartu acak di tangan target; target boleh membuang 1 kartu untuk mencegah pemeriksaan tangan (tetapi Bukti tetap diperoleh).

en.name: Spotlight
en.text: All players show their Suspicion markers; draw 1 card.

id.name: Sorotan
id.text: Semua pemain menunjukkan penanda Kecurigaan; ambil 1 kartu.

en.name: Misdirection
en.text: Reaction to investigation: prevent someone from looking at your hand; Evidence from their card still applies.

id.name: Pengalihan
id.text: Reaksi terhadap penyelidikan: cegah pemain lain melihat tanganmu; Bukti yang sah tetap diperoleh.
